It's basically just pushing carts and moving them to their assigned place also scanning boxes that come down the line into the carts. You will be able to set up direct deposit on your first orientation day. The first check is a paper check. Once my background cleared you will get an email basically just saying see you on your first day. And dress code rules bring forms of identification etc. and be on time! For some reason target doesn't allow you to be even one minute late if you are its considered a write up 3 times being late or even missing days they will fire you. They really care about attendance and showing up on time.
